title: Identify the Italian constructor that has accumulated the highest total poi
question: Identify the Italian constructor that has accumulated the highest total points from the Spanish Grand Prix races held between 1990 and 2005. Return the constructor’s name, nationality, total points, and the URL to its introduction page.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T2."XCL_024", T2."XCL_025", SUM(T1."XCL_013") AS total_points, T2."XCL_026"
FROM constructorResults AS T1
INNER JOIN constructors AS T2 ON T1."XCL_012" = T2."XCL_022"
INNER JOIN races AS T3 ON T3."XCL_065" = T1."XCL_011"
WHERE T3."XCL_069" = 'Spanish Grand Prix'
  AND T3."XCL_066" BETWEEN 1990 AND 2005
  AND T2."XCL_025" = 'Italian'
GROUP BY T2."XCL_022", T2."XCL_024", T2."XCL_025", T2."XCL_026"
ORDER BY total_points DESC
LIMIT 1

roles.description: Lap time recorded in the first qualifying session (Q1). This is the most frequently populated time column, serving as the baseline for all qualifying entries.

structural_constraints.description: Participation in the second qualifying session (Q2) implies participation in the first qualifying session (Q1). The data confirms this: every row with a Q2 time has a Q1 time, but many rows with a Q1 time do not have a Q2 time.

Participation in the third qualifying session (Q3) implies participation in the second qualifying session (Q2). The data confirms this: every row with a Q3 time has a Q2 time, but many rows with a Q2 time do not have a Q3 time.
